home.title: Intelligent Retinal Screening for Early Detection
home.subtitle: NeuroVista-DR uses advanced AI to analyze fundus images and help detect diabetic retinopathy early — supporting doctors with fast, explainable screening results.
home.secondaryInfo: AI-assisted screening tool — not a diagnostic device. For ophthalmologist review.

1.title: Upload Fundus Image
1.desc: Capture or upload a photo of the back of the eye taken by a fundus camera.

2.title: AI Analysis
2.desc: The system checks image quality and analyzes the retina for signs of diabetic retinopathy.

3.title: Screening Result
3.desc: Receive a DR grade, severity and referral recommendation with confidence score.

4.title: Explanation & Report
4.desc: Review model explanations and a printable clinical screening report.
